I write about the things I genuinely enjoy growing, wearing, and using.

Rachel Living is where I share what I’ve learned along the way, from growing plants in my backyard to finding clothes I actually want to wear and simpler ways to keep my home clean.

Some of my guides are research-backed. Others come from years of trying things for myself. Either way, I’m interested in what works in real life.
